per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should provide clear and immediate feedback when a booking is confirmed.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall give users feedback when necessary. 80% of the users surveyed report that the product accurately confirms their actions.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should respond to small actions in under 5 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The response shall be fast enough to avoid interrupting the user's flow of thought. 90% of tasks shall complete within 5 seconds. 98% of tasks shall complete within 8 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should complete most tasks in under 10 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The response shall be fast enough to avoid interrupting the user's flow of thought. 90% of tasks shall complete within 5 seconds. 98% of tasks shall complete within 8 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should provide reliable search results to prevent double-booking.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall allow for intuitive searching of available conference rooms.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be tested on at least eight different browsers.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must be able to interface with any HTML browser. The product shall transmit data between the user and the product without problems. The product shall display HTML properly in 80% of all HTML browsers tested (minimum is to test 8 browsers).'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should provide actionable error messages that explain conflicts and suggest alternatives.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall give users feedback when necessary. 80% of the users surveyed report that the product accurately confirms their actions.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should support multiple email servers, both internal and external.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must be able to interface with various email servers. The product shall be able to send email.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should support multiple languages and correct date/time formats for different locales.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The product shall be able to display calendar dates and times according to the user's locale. 90% of survey respondents from each target market country will find that the date and time formatting of the product is correct.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be accessible to users with disabilities, including support for screen readers, keyboard navigation, and high-contrast themes.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should have a very high uptime, close to 100%.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Aside from server failure the software product shall achieve 99.99% up time.'

The system should integrate equipment requests (e.g., projectors, laptops) into the booking flow.
